Commentary.Commentary: SOHAIL KHAN is back into the attack!
Full around middle and leg, Holder hits it down the ground for a single.
SIX! That ball sailed away! Flighted ball around middle and off, Holder makes room and goes inside out. He connected it so, so well that it sailed over the wide long off fence for a maximum.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, driven through covers.
Full and around off, Denesh leans forward and pushes it towards covers.
Tossed up ball around middle and leg, eased down to long on for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up ball around middle and leg, Ramdin works it towards mid on for a single.
Pushed towards the man at covers for no runs.
Defended off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, Holder makes room and drives it towards covers for a single.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy delivery around middle and off, Jason punches it towards the cover region.
Short and outside off, Holder punches it off the back foot towards covers.
Around middle and leg, flicked through mid off for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy delivery around off, pushed through mid off for a single.
JASON HOLDER is the new man in!

OUT! In the air... gone! What a catch by Malik! Pollard has to walk back, another disappointing dismissal this. Nawaz gives this one a bit more flight around off, Pollard lunges forward and tries to loft it. His intention was to clear long off but it didn't come off the meat of the bat. Malik in the deep comes forward and gobbles it beautifully. Really a tough catch but he made that look so easy. So, half the side is back in the hut and this chase is going nowhere.
Flattish on the stumps, Kieron walks across and tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Pollard presses forward and defends it down.
Ramdin gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards long on for a single.
Around middle and leg, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Short and around off, punched towards covers.
Loopy delivery around off, driven down to long off for a single.
Short and outside off, Ramdin gets back and cuts it hard but much to his disappointment the ball goes straight to backward point.
Driven hard by Ramdin but straight to the fielder at covers.
Nicely tossed up ball around off, Pollard pushes it towards covers and scampers across for a quick single.
Flatter and stays low as well, Pollard pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball around off, Ramdin drives it through mid off for a single.
Tossed up around off, driven straight to the man at short covers.
A bit of loop from Imad Wasim, the flight allows Ramdin the time to see the ball well and turn it to mid-wicket for a single.
Drifting in with the angle, Kieron adjusts his body late and hits it down to long on for a run.
Bowls it slower through the air, loops it up on the stumps, it's pushed back down the track.
Once again it's outside off, crunched through the gap in the off side for one.
Short and flat outside off, Denesh rocks back and punches it through the covers for a couple of good runs.
Full on the stumps, eased down to long on for a single.
IMAD WASIM comes on to bowl.
Tossed up and attacking the stumps, it's hit straight back to the bowler.
Full on the stumps, driven down to long on for one run.
Floats this one up right up there, outside off, Pollard lungs forward and blocks it solidly to the off side.
Almost an edge. Tossed up nicely well outside off, Kieron Pollard tries to play this away from his body but gets beaten as the ball goes past the outside edge.

Much straighter from Nawaz, full and loopy on middle and leg, Pollard clears his front leg and drives it straight back down the ground. Gets two runs as the fielder from long on comes across to cut it off.
Tosses it up outside off, Kieron pushes it to the off side off his front foot.
Pollard works this length delivery to the mid-wicket region for a quick single to end the over.
Pitched just back of a length and angling in once more, Kieron is hit on the body as he looks to play at that.
Back of a length delivery around off, tight line which cramps Pollard for room. He can only tap it down into the ground on the off side.
Fired in full and well outside off, width on offer as Denesh leans into the drive. Gets it off the middle and creams it to deep cover for a single.

FOUR! INSIDE EDGE AND THAT'S AWAY! Another one which could have been dragged on. Length ball angling in around off, it's coming in sharply and Ramdin looks to put bat on ball. He gets a big inside edge which whiskers past the leg stump and races away to the fine leg fence.
Continues from around the wicket and bowls a length ball just outside off, Ramdin stays behind the line and keeps it out off the back foot.
Loopy delivery around middle and off, Ramdin punches it towards covers for a single to keep strike.
Full and around off, pushed towards point.
Flattish around middle and off, comes in as well. Ramdin looks to push but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Short ball around the off stump, cuts it towards point off the back foot.
Flattish on middle, punched down to long on for a single.
Tossed up ball around off, Pollard leans forward to defend but the ball turns away and he gets beaten.
MOHAMMAD NAWAZ is brought into the attack.
Slightly fuller in length and on middle, it's worked in front of mid-wicket for a brisk single. Another successful over from Wahab Riaz comes to an end.

ALMOST DRAGGED IT ON! Length delivery just outside off, a really tight line, Ramdin gets an inside edge onto his boot as he tries to put bat on ball. Could have just as easily dragged in back on to the stumps. The batsmen take a single as the ball rolls over to the leg side.
On a good length once more, outside off, blocked.
Length delivery outside off, it's punched in front of covers off the back foot.
KIERON POLLARD is the new man in!

OUT! MARLON WALKS WITH A FORLORN FACE! Huge, huge mix-up out in the middle there. Absolutely embarrassing stuff. On a length and coming in from outside off, Ramdin opens the face a bit and punches it to cover-point. He calls for a single, Samuels responds and then at the last second, Denesh decides to turn back. Samuels is more than halfway down the track and is in no man's land now. Mohammad Rizwan is the fielder at cover-point and he has great presence of mind. He doesn't senselessly throw the ball. Instead, he runs to the stumps at the bowler's end seeing Samuels a long way out. Takes the bails off on his own and leaves the batsman with no choice. Great stuff.
From around the wicket to Denesh Ramdin, Wahab with a fuller length ball angling in from outside off, Ramdin gets behind the line and keeps it out with a straight blade.
FOUR! That's creamed! Tossed up ball around off, Samuels camps back and hits it through covers for another boundary. Absolutely no need to run for those.
Tossed up around middle and off, Ramdin works it towards mid on for a single.
Around middle and leg, flicked towards mid on for a single.
Flat and outside off, Samuels looks to cut but gets an outside edge towards short third man.
Short and outside off, Samuels goes after it as he punches it towards covers where the fielder dives to his left and stops a certain boundary.
Loopy full around middle, flicked towards mid on.
DENESH RAMDIN is the new man in!

OUT! WAHAB RIAZ, YOU BEAUTY! Started causing trouble right from the moment he came into the attack and has got the reward. He comes running in, bowls a length ball in the channel outside off. Bravo was probably expecting the short one and hence camped back. The ball was going away from him at the last moment and that got him. Caught the outside edge and Sarfraz behind the stumps took a simple catch. Great carry on that as the ball was taken by the keeper. Wahab Riaz once again looks to be in his element. Superb bowling, this.
On a length and outside off, hit to cover-point for nothing.
Fullish in length and pitched up there to Samuels, he drives it to deep extra cover for a single.
Length ball on middle and leg, coming in to Marlon Samuels, he tucks this to backward square leg and runs hard to take a couple of runs.
Full and pitched outside off, Darren drives it towards sweeper cover and takes a good single.

That was really, really close! Wow. Once again Wahab beats the batsman for pace. 139 kph, Wahab Riaz fires in a full ball angling in, raps Bravo low on the pads as he attempts to flick. Misses and is hit on the pads and Wahab instantly appeals for a leg before. It's turned down and rightly so, it was just going down leg. Wahab Riaz has immediately cranked things up here.
Darted around middle, eased down to mid on for a single.
Around middle and off, it's flat as well. Samuels punches it through covers for a single.

BOLDSTARTS Brilliant stop from Nawaz! BOLDENDS Tossed up around middle and leg, Samuels flicks it through mid-wicket. It was all set to race away before Nawaz came running in to his left, puts in a dive to stop it with one hand. Two runs taken.
Loopy delivery around off, driven through mid off for a single.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot through covers for a single.
Around middle and leg, flicked towards the leg side.

Another full delivery on the stumps, Marlon pushes this towards mid on and sets off for a quick single, taking the fielder there on. A throw is fired in at the bowler's end but it misses and the batsmen complete a single.
Too straight this time as he spears in a full ball on middle and off, it's worked towards mid-wicket for no run.
Length ball angling in to Marlon Samuels, raps him on the pads as he tries to put bat on ball. Beating him for pace there once more.

Wahab Riaz has a change a angle and comes from around the wicket, fires in a fuller ball outside off and gets it to angle in. It beats the outside edge of Samuels' bat and goes into the keeper's gloves.
Fuller in length once more and around off, pushed to the covers a single.
Wahab comes charging in and pitches it outside off, a yorker which Bravo fails to put any bat on ball.
WAHAB RIAZ is brought into the bowling attack.
Another one on the stumps, it's flicked to mid-wicket.
Fullish and flatter just outside off, drifting away, it's kept out off the back foot with a straight bat.
MARLON SAMUELS is the next batsman in.

OUT! MALIK GETS HIS MAN! He comes from around the wicket and tosses it up on middle and off, it's the off-spinner and not the arm ball. It comes back in a touch and raps Brathwaite on the front pad as he comes forward to flick it away. Malik turns around and appeals as loud as possible and after a good long while, the umpire raises his finger. Kraigg takes a review against the decision as he feels he might be safe here and the decision goes upstairs. Replay show that he is gone. The ball pitched in line, the impact was in line and was hitting the stumps. Now, both openers are back in the hut and Pakistan are on top here.
Kraigg Brathwaite is caught leg before and has been given out. He isn't convinced and decides to take the review against the decision.
Flatter one outside off, shorter in length as well, it's run down to third man for a single.
This is worked towards square leg for a single.
Continues from around the wicket and tosses it up on middle and off, it's worked towards mid-wicket for nothing.

SIX! THAT'S A BIG HIT! And one West Indies have desperately needed. That should relieve some pressure off the batsmen. Flat and short on middle stump, Bravo rocks back in a jiffy and pulls it with all his might over the mid-wicket boundary for a maximum.
This fuller delivery is worked towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Flatter and shorter outside off, drifting in, Bravo cuts it away but it's straight to the cover-point fielder.
Flat and shorter in length, outside off, Brathwaite camps back and punches it down to long off for a single.
Full and aiming the base of off stump, pushed back into the hands of the bowler.
From around the wicket, it's flat and outside off, punched to the left of the bowler for no run.
Flatter and shorter outside off, cut away towards backward point for a run.
Some nice flight given on this, loops it up nicely on middle and off, Bravo clears his front leg and drives it down to long off for a single.
Malik tosses it up there, on the stumps, it's turned to square leg with the spin for another run.
Short and wide outside off, Darren rocks back and punches it through to deep cover for one.
Another flatter ball around off, it's worked to the right of the bowler for a quick single.
From around the wicket, a flat ball outside off, it's bunted back in the direction of the bowler from within the crease.
Fullish on off, DB drives it back to the bowler.
Landed around off, Bravo gets onto his front foot and defends.
On middle and leg, KB works it through the leg side for three runs.
FOUR! Fine shot! Shortish outside off, Brathwaite goes onto his back foot and cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
Landed outside off, Bravo punches it to long on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Bravo plays it towards point.
MOHAMMAD NAWAZ into the attack.
Landed outside off, Bravo pushes it through covers for a single.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
On middle and off, Darren defends it solidly.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Bravo tries to flick but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
Landed around off, Bravo defends it into the ground.
On middle and leg, Kraigg flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on the pads, Brathwaite tries to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. Appeal for an lbw turned down by the umpire.
Landed around the off stump line, Bravo defends it with soft hands.
Fuller length ball outside off, Bravo pushes it to covers.
Good length ball around off, Bravo gets onto his front foot and defends.
Fuller length ball on off, Bravo pushes it towards mid off.
Back of a length ball on off, Bravo tries to push it to the off side but the ball goes off the outside edge towards the keeper, off one bounce though.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Landed around off, Brathwaite defends it to the on side.
Outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Arm ball outside off, Bravo tries to push but misses.
Flighted outside off, Bravo drives it towards cover.
Full ball on off, Bravo digs it out.
Is that a doosra? It's pitched way outside off, Bravo tries to push but misses it completely.
SHOAIB MALIK into the attack.
On the pads, Bravo works it through the leg side for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Darren pushes it towards point.
Landed around off, Bravo defends it into the ground.
Good length ball outside off, Brathwaite guides it to third man for a single.
On middle and leg, angling in, Bravo tries to play it across but the ball goes off the pads towards square leg. Leg bye taken.
Good length ball on off, Bravo taps it towards point.
Slightly fullish in length and homing in on middle and leg, it's worked towards mid-wicket for no run once more.
On a good length and pitched outside off, Kraigg punches it towards point. Won't get any run for it, though.
Bye! Full and going away from the batsman, it's left alone and the keeper misses it as well. A bye is taken by the batsmen.
A yorker arrowed in on middle and off, swinging in, Bravo does well to squeeze it out back down the track.
DARREN BRAVO walks out to bat.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! No need for the umpire on this occasion. He's knocked the bails over. Fuller length delivery on leg, Evin Lewis walks across a little too much this time as he attempts to flick it away. He misses and his stumps are completely exposed. The bails are off and the southpaw has to make the long walk back. Pakistan with the breakthrough just at the right moment. The partnership was just taking off and Evin Lewis was about to cut loose.

FOUR! He's looking good and looking dangerous here! Sohail Khan with a fuller length delivery across the batsman, Lewis walks across and smashes this hard through the covers for a boundary. Nobody even moved for that as the ball rocketed away to the boundary ropes.
Length ball outside off, it's punched straight to the cover fielder off the back foot.
Pitched just back of a length around the off stump, Evin Lewis walks across and short-arm jabs it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Just back of a length outside, punched away for no run.
Length delivery just outside off, good line from Hasan Ali. Kraigg Brathwaite stays deep within his crease and defends it with a solid, straight bat.

Leg bye! HUGE LBW APPEAL! But once again it's turned down, with the same batsman in the spotlight and for the same reason too. Deja vu! Hasan Ali come steaming in and fires in a full ball coming in on middle and leg, Lewis is rapped low on the pads as he tries to flick. He misses and is struck on the pads. Huge appeal for an lbw turned down as the ball pitched outside the line of leg stump. A leg bye is taken.
HASAN ALI is into the attack.
On middle and off, KB stays back in his crease and defends.
Good length ball around off, Brathwaite covers the line and defends it into the ground.

NOT OUT! On the pads, Lewis tries to play it across but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for a leg before but the umpire says not out. Pakistan decide to review but replays show it's pitched outside leg. Lewis survives and Pakistan have lost their review. Leg bye taken too.
Evin Lewis is caught leg before once more but this time adjudged not out. Pakistan decide to take a review against the decision now.

NOT OUT! Well, that was extremely close. Just half a centimetre to the right and the southpaw would have been gone. Sohail Khan comes charging in and bowls a length ball coming in on middle and leg. Evin Lewis stays back and looks to flick it away but is rapped on the pads. There are loud appeals for a leg before and after taking his time, raises his finger. Lewis is not convinced and after talking to his partner, decides to take a review. Replays show that the ball just pitched outside the line of leg stump. Was real close. Real close. The left-hander survives as the review is a successful one.
Lewis is caught leg before and adjudged out. He decides to take a review against the decision.
Fullish in length and pitched outside off, some lovely width on offer here. Evin Lewis leans into the drive and creams it straight to the man at covers.
Length delivery angling away from the batsman, it's run down to third man for one run.

FOUR! Two in two for Evin! He rocks back to his flat and short delivery and crunches it through cover-point to send it all the way. Beautiful shot. He took a bit to get going but now is coming into his own.
FOUR! Poor line, poor length and that's punished. Flat on the pads, Evin Lewis transfers his weight on his back foot and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Outside off, it's punched off the back foot towards the mid off fielder.
Flatter once more and pitched outside off, it's punched to the off side.
Flat and shorter outside off, the ball keeps a little low as Lewis cuts it to cover-point.
Full and drifting in around off, it's wristed down to long on for one run.
Full and attacking the stumps here, it's worked to the on side by Evin Lewis for nothing. That will the end of the over.
FOUR! THAT'S SWEETLY TIMED! Wonderfully played. Full and on the pads, poor line and that's been dealt with. Lewis stands tall to this one and flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Hits the deck hard, a back of a length ball outside off, Evin Lewis takes a step across and is then cramped for room as he attempts to cut it away. Ends up getting a bottom edge into the track.
Fuller length ball angled across the left-hander, Lewis plants his front foot forward and drives it hard straight to the man at cover-point.
Sohail Khan fires in a yorker on off, swinging away, Kraigg manages to squeeze it out to the on side and takes a quick single.
On a length once more but it's a tighter line this time, just around the off stump, kept out solidly off the back foot.
Wide! On a good length and well outside off, Brathwaite leaves it alone as the ball heavily shapes away. It's signalled as a wide as the ball crossed the wide line.
Quicker through the air and around off, Lewis defends it on the leg side.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Around the leg stump, clipped towards short mid-wicket.
Flatter one around middle and off, punched off the back foot through wide mid on for a couple.
Loopy delivery around middle and off, punched towards covers for a single.
Short and outside off, Lewis punches it off the back foot towards point.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and strayed down the leg side, the batsman goes after it but misses.
Full and angling on middle, Brathwaite transfers his weight on the front foot and bunts it down the ground past mid on. The fielder gives it a chase and keeps the batsmen down to a couple.
Wide! On a length and shapes a bit too much this time outside off. It's left alone as the umpire stretches his arms.
FOUR! Shot, that! On a length and had width on offer too. Kraigg cuts it past point and it speeds away to the fence. The great Ramiz Raja on air says - "It's a confidence-lifter shot!"
Almost chopped on! Fuller in length and angling across. Brathwaite looks to drive but gets an inside edge just past the stumps to fine leg. Two runs taken.
On a length and angling in, Brathwaite gets forward and pushes it towards mid on.
Flattish on middle, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single.

Tossed up ball around middle and leg, Lewis gets down on one knee and looks to sweep. Drags it off the inner half of the bat towards fine leg. The fielder gives it a chase and saves a run for his side. Three taken in the end.
Full and on middle, Lewis flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Short and around off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Darts it around off, skids after pitching. Lewis tries to punch it on the off side but fails to get any bat on it.
Full and around off, Lewis pushes it straight to the man at short cover.
Fuller in length and moving away after pitching. Kraigg Brathwiate makes a watchful leave yet again.
Good length delivery, coming in this time, Brathwaite is happy to leave it.
In the channel outside off, Kraigg lifts his bat and lets it go.
Beauty! Pitches this one on a length around off, Brathwaite comes forward to defend but the ball shapes away and just whizzes past the outside edge to the keeper.
Wide! Good length delivery around off, it swings away after pitching. KB lets it go and Sarfraz behind the stumps fails to collect it with a dive to his right.
On a length and angling in, Kraigg defends it off the front foot on the leg side.
FOUR! Sohail Khan starts with a wayward delivery down the leg side, Brathwaite just helps it on its way down to fine leg for a boundary.
SOHAIL KHAN will bowl from the other end!
Flighted delivery around middle and off, Evin defends it with a straight bat.
Full and around off, defended into the ground.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, Lewis defends it off the back foot.
Tossed up around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark.
Flat and quicker around middle, Kraigg looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire says not out.
Starts with a loopy delivery around off, Brathwaite flicks it towards short mid-wicket.

Welcome back for the run chase! West Indies have a huge task ahead of them if they are to salvage some pride. Debutant EVIN LEWIS and KRAIGG BRATHWAITE will open the batting for the visitors. IMAD WASIM will start off with the bowling proceedings. Let's play!!!
